## History

Harmon Andrews is a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community who suffers severe crop and property damage when a sudden and devastating hail storm strikes the village. Following [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's two-year tenure as the local schoolteacher, Harmon's wife, Mrs. Harmon Andrews, participates in village gossip regarding Anne's success as a teacher and the local affairs of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV.
